The ECOM E511G-XP-F670 1GE Single Port XPON ONU is a universal FTTH solution that delivers high-speed, stable, and energy-efficient fiber connectivity. Supporting dual-mode EPON and GPON, this ONU ensures seamless compatibility with any brand OLT, including Huawei, VSOL, BDCOM, and C-DATA.


Designed for residential and small business networks, it features a single Gigabit Ethernet (1GE) port to provide ultra-fast internet suitable for 4K streaming, gaming, VoIP, and heavy data usage. With low power consumption (<3.5W) and a DC 12V/0.5A power adapter, it operates efficiently while maintaining stable performance. The device uses an SC/APC optical connector for reliable and strong optical signal transmission.

Compact, easy to install, and ISP-friendly, the E511G-XP-F670 is the ideal ONU for Bangladeshi FTTH deployments.


Key Features:

  • XPON ONU supporting EPON & GPON dual-mode
  • Fully compatible with Huawei, VSOL, BDCOM, C-DATA, and other OLT brands
  • 1GE Gigabit Ethernet port for ultra-fast wired connectivity
  • SC/APC fiber connector for stable signal quality
  • Low power consumption (<3.5W) with DC 12V/0.5A power adapter
  • Compact & lightweight design for easy installation
  • Perfect for FTTH applications in home and office networks
